about: Intended placements the placement audit (npm run audit:placement) may report. Globs match item keys, owners or assets (see renderer/src/farm/dev/placementCore.ts). Every entry needs a reason; 'max' caps the metric (bigger still surfaces), 'min' requires extra metrics (e.g. base separation).

entries.reason: apples hang in the orchard trees' crowns (supported by the crop:tree instance, not by anything under them)
grape bunches hang from the vines on the trellis wires
sunflower heads sit on top of their stalks (crop:sunplant)
vines grow on and through the trellis by design
grapes hang on the trellis

neighbouring crowns interleave in a forest; scatter keeps trunks ≥ 0.7 × (crown radii) apart, so only crowns touch (sepRatio = base distance / half-widths)
